content.title: Mortgage Rates Fall: Current Averages for Home Loans & Refinancing
content.text: April 13, 2026 at 12:51 AM GMT-5Current Mortgage and Refinance RatesMortgage rates are significantly lower than last weekend. The Zillow lender marketplace is reporting an average 30-year fixed mortgage of 6.15%, down seven basis points from last weekend. The average 15-year fixed rate is 5.64%. According to the latest Zillow data, current mortgage rates include a 20-year fixed at 5.97%, a 5/1 ARM at 6.44%, and a 7/1 ARM at 6.36%. For VA loans, averages are 5.73% for a 30-year term, 5.38% for a 15-year term, and 5.58% for a 5/1 ARM. 1.
